watches.name: H4.2 Celestiale Gradients (Copy)
watches.description: The Celestiale Gradient closes the trilogy with a quiet radicality. Zones of shadow and points of light are arranged in a controlled contrast that lends the dial an almost sculptural relief. Maximum visual depth, in a watch that does not seek to be noticed. Beneath the sapphire crystal, a Sellita automatic calibre, based in La Chaux-de-Fonds, and COSC-certified. The Contrôle officiel suisse des chronomètres – also based in La Chaux-de-Fonds. The bracelet remains tool-free interchangeable – integrated steel or rubber – because a watch with depth must also be a practical watch. The H4.2 is designed to be worn daily, without ceremony. The H4.2 is produced in a limited edition of 992 pieces per reference.
